authority: Static House Tang departure-issue policy. Mutable ammunition remains owned by the House garrison depot and mutable equipment remains owned by the House armory inventory until exact formation issue. Ordinary army ration/feed is derived strategic support, not formation inventory.

field_service_preparation.rule: When Tang Wei orders campaign preparation for House-controlled field formations at Tang Manor, House quartermasters raise formation arrow custody to the registered expedition load and stage spare registered loadout equipment from exact on-hand armory reserve. Ordinary baggage accompanies the army and ration/feed readiness is derived from current strategic support rather than stored as formation inventory. Missing ammunition or equipment remains an explicit shortfall for normal production or lawful procurement; replacement mounts require a separate exact order.
